knowledge.name: Unit 1 How do we spend our free time?
空闲活动的词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we spend our free time?
knowledge.explanation: 本单元学习表达课余活动的动词短语，如 read books、play football。

knowledge.name: 频率副词
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we spend our free time?
knowledge.explanation: often、sometimes、always、never 用来说明动作发生的频率。

knowledge.name: 询问与回答空闲活动
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we spend our free time?
knowledge.explanation: 用 What do you do in your free time? 询问，用 I often … 回答。

knowledge.name: 本单元的语音与书写
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 How do we spend our free time?
knowledge.explanation: 注意字母组合的发音，书写句子时句首字母要大写。

knowledge.name: Unit 2 How do we make friends?
描述朋友的形容词
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 How do we make friends?
knowledge.explanation: 用 friendly、kind、clever 等形容词描述朋友的性格。

knowledge.name: 介绍他人的句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 How do we make friends?
knowledge.explanation: 用 This is … 介绍他人，用 He/She is … 描述特点。

knowledge.name: 交友的礼貌表达
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 How do we make friends?
knowledge.explanation: 用 Can I …? / Let's … 等句式提出请求与建议，语气礼貌。

knowledge.name: 本单元的字母与发音
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 How do we make friends?
knowledge.explanation: 注意 th 的两种发音，以及句子的升降调。

knowledge.name: 衣物词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What do we wear?
knowledge.explanation: 学习 coat、shirt、dress、shoes 等衣物名称。

knowledge.name: 穿着表达
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What do we wear?
knowledge.explanation: 用 wear 表示穿着，注意第三人称单数加 s。

knowledge.name: 天气与衣物的搭配
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What do we wear?
knowledge.explanation: 不同天气穿不同衣物，用 It is … 描述天气。

knowledge.name: 本单元的疑问句
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What do we wear?
knowledge.explanation: 用 What do you wear …? 询问穿着，回答用 I wear …。

knowledge.name: Unit 4 What sounds can we hear?
声音词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What sounds can we hear?
knowledge.explanation: 学习 bell、rain、car、bird 等声音来源与拟声表达。

knowledge.name: 感官动词 hear 的用法
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What sounds can we hear?
knowledge.explanation: hear 表示听见，后可接名词或动词的 ing 形式。

knowledge.name: 描述声音的形容词
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What sounds can we hear?
knowledge.explanation: 用 loud、soft、quiet 等词描述声音的特点。

knowledge.name: Unit 4 的语音与语调
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What sounds can we hear?
knowledge.explanation: 注意 sh、ch 的发音，感叹句用降调。

knowledge.name: Unit 5 Where can we see colours?
颜色词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 Where can we see colours?
knowledge.explanation: 学习 red、yellow、blue、green、purple 等颜色词。

knowledge.name: 询问颜色的句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 Where can we see colours?
knowledge.explanation: 用 What colour is …? 询问颜色，用 It is … 回答。

knowledge.name: 颜色的表达与喜好
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 Where can we see colours?
knowledge.explanation: 用 like 表达对颜色的喜好，用 because 说明原因。

knowledge.name: Unit 5 的颜色语言运用
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 Where can we see colours?
knowledge.explanation: 把颜色词与衣物、物品结合描述，形成完整句子。

knowledge.name: Unit 6 What are our homes like?
房间与家具词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 What are our homes like?
knowledge.explanation: 学习 living room、bedroom、kitchen、sofa、bed 等词。

knowledge.name: There be 句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 What are our homes like?
knowledge.explanation: 用 There is / There are 表示某处有某物。

knowledge.name: 方位介词
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 What are our homes like?
knowledge.explanation: 用 in、on、under、behind 等介词说明物品位置。

knowledge.name: 描述家的语言运用
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 What are our homes like?
knowledge.explanation: 把房间、家具与方位结合，写出完整的描述段落。

knowledge.name: Unit 7 What do we do at school?
学校活动词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 7 What do we do at school?
knowledge.explanation: 学习 have a class、play sports、read in the library 等表达。

knowledge.name: 课程与时间表达
knowledge.parent: Unit 7 What do we do at school?
knowledge.explanation: 用 We have … on … 表示某天上什么课，用 at … 表示时间点。

knowledge.name: 询问学校生活
knowledge.parent: Unit 7 What do we do at school?
knowledge.explanation: 用 What do you do at school? / When do you …? 询问。

knowledge.name: Unit 7 的语音与语调
knowledge.parent: Unit 7 What do we do at school?
knowledge.explanation: 注意字母组合 oo 的读音，特殊疑问句用降调。

knowledge.name: Unit 8 What do you do on Children's Day?
节日活动词汇
knowledge.parent: Unit 8 What do you do on Children's Day?
knowledge.explanation: 学习 sing songs、watch a show、eat cakes 等节日活动表达。

knowledge.name: 时间与日期的表达
knowledge.parent: Unit 8 What do you do on Children's Day?
knowledge.explanation: 用 on June 1st 表示日期，用 at … 表示时刻。

knowledge.name: 祝愿与感谢
knowledge.parent: Unit 8 What do you do on Children's Day?
knowledge.explanation: 用 Happy Children's Day! 表达祝愿，用 Thank you 回应。

knowledge.name: Unit 8 的节日语言运用
knowledge.parent: Unit 8 What do you do on Children's Day?
knowledge.explanation: 把节日、活动与时间结合，写一段完整的节日描述。

chapters.name: Unit 1 How do we spend our free time?
chapters.summary: 谈论空闲时间的活动，用一般现在时表达习惯。

questions.stem: I often ___ books in my free time.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 后用动词原形 read。

questions.stem: 补全短语：play ___（足球）。
questions.analysis: play football 表示踢足球。

questions.stem: 「draw pictures」的意思是画画。
questions.analysis: draw pictures 意为画画。

questions.stem: 属于空闲活动的短语有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓ read books；B ✓ play the piano；C ✓ do homework；D ✗ 是日常作息不是课余活动。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用英语写两句话介绍你的空闲时间活动。

answer.value: 示例：I often read books after school. I sometimes play football with my friends.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句完整 + 动词形式正确。

questions.stem: He ___ plays basketball after school.
questions.analysis: often 本身就是频率副词。

questions.stem: 表示「从不」的频率副词是 ___。
questions.analysis: never 意为从不。

questions.stem: 频率副词通常放在实义动词之前。
questions.analysis: 如 He often plays。

questions.stem: 表示频率的词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都是频率副词；D ✗ quickly 表方式。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用 never 写一句关于你自己习惯的话。

answer.value: 示例：I never watch TV on school nights.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：never 位置正确 + 句意通顺。

questions.stem: — What do you do in your free time? — ___
questions.analysis: 问习惯用一般现在时回答。

questions.stem: 补全问句：___ do you do in your free time?
questions.analysis: 用 What 询问做什么。

questions.stem: 回答 What do you do 的问题时可以用 often 等频率副词。
questions.analysis: 频率副词使回答更具体。

questions.stem: 可以回答空闲活动问题的句子有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都说明活动；D ✗ 回答年龄。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写一组问答，询问并回答周末活动。

answer.value: 示例：— What do you do at the weekend? — I often ride a bike with my father.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：问句正确 + 回答完整。

questions.stem: 单词 read 中字母组合 ea 的发音与下面哪个相同？
questions.analysis: read 与 tea 中 ea 发音相同。

questions.stem: 句子开头第一个字母要（ ）写。
questions.analysis: 句首字母须大写。

questions.stem: 英语句末要加标点符号。
questions.analysis: 句子结尾需标点。

questions.stem: 书写英语句子时要注意（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 不应全部大写。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 改正下面句子的书写错误：i often read books.

answer.value: 示例：I often read books. 句首字母 i 应改为大写 I。

questions.analysis: 评分要点：指出错误 + 改正正确。

chapters.name: Unit 2 How do we make friends?
chapters.summary: 学习介绍朋友、描述他人与交友表达。

questions.stem: My friend is very ___. She always helps others.
questions.analysis: help others 说明她善良。

questions.stem: 形容一个人友好可以用单词 ___。
questions.analysis: friendly 意为友好的。

questions.stem: 形容词可以放在 be 动词后面描述人。
questions.analysis: 如 She is kind。

questions.stem: 可以描述朋友性格的词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都是性格词；D ✗ long 描述长度。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用两个形容词介绍你的好朋友。

answer.value: 示例：My good friend is kind and clever. She often helps me with my English.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个形容词 + 语句通顺。

questions.stem: ___ is my new friend, Amy.
questions.analysis: 介绍单个人用 This is。

questions.stem: 补全句子：She ___ (be) my classmate.
questions.analysis: 第三人称单数用 is。

questions.stem: 介绍两个人时可以说 These are my friends.
questions.analysis: 复数用 These are。

questions.stem: 介绍朋友时可以说的句子有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ am 与 he 不搭配。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写三句话介绍你的同桌。

answer.value: 示例：This is my deskmate, Li Ming. He is nine years old. He likes drawing pictures.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：介绍 + 年龄 + 爱好。

questions.stem: ___ we play together?
questions.analysis: 提出请求用 Can we …。

questions.stem: 补全建议句：___ be friends!（填 Let 或 Lets 中的正确形式）
questions.analysis: Let's 表示我们一起吧。

questions.stem: 提出请求时加上 please 会更礼貌。
questions.analysis: please 使语气礼貌。

questions.stem: 礼貌的交友表达有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都礼貌；D ✗ 语气生硬。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写一句邀请同学一起玩的礼貌句子。

answer.value: 示例：Can you play football with me after school, please?

questions.analysis: 评分要点：句式礼貌 + 意思清楚。

questions.stem: 单词 three 中 th 的发音是（ ）。
questions.analysis: three 中 th 读清辅音。

questions.stem: 单词 this 中 th 发（ ）辅音（填清或浊）。
questions.analysis: this 中 th 为浊辅音。

questions.stem: 一般疑问句通常用升调朗读。
questions.analysis: 一般疑问句句末升调。

questions.stem: 含 th 的单词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都含 th；D ✗ 不含 th。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 朗读下面句子并说明句末语调：Is she your friend?

answer.value: 示例：这是一般疑问句，朗读时句末用升调。

questions.analysis: 评分要点：指出疑问句 + 升调。

chapters.name: Unit 3 What do we wear?
chapters.summary: 学习衣物词汇与穿着表达。

questions.stem: In winter we wear a warm ___.
questions.analysis: 冬天穿暖和的外套。

questions.stem: 表示鞋子的单词（复数）是 ___。
questions.analysis: shoes 表示鞋。

questions.stem: dress 通常指连衣裙。
questions.analysis: dress 是连衣裙。

questions.stem: 属于衣物的单词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 是水果。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写出你冬天常穿的三件衣物。

answer.value: 示例：I often wear a coat, a sweater and a pair of trousers in winter.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三件衣物 + 句子完整。

questions.stem: She ___ a red dress today.
questions.analysis: 第三人称单数用 wears。

questions.stem: 补全句子：I ___ (wear) a white shirt on Mondays.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 用原形。

questions.stem: 表示穿着状态也可以用 be wearing。
questions.analysis: 如 He is wearing a jacket。

questions.stem: 下面句子语法正确的有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；D ✓；C ✗ 应为 wears。所以选 A、B、D。

questions.stem: 写两句话说明你和你朋友今天的穿着。

answer.value: 示例：I am wearing a yellow T-shirt and blue trousers. My friend is wearing a white skirt.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两人各一句 + 时态正确。

questions.stem: It is cold today. You need a ___.
questions.analysis: 天冷需要围巾。

questions.stem: 天气炎热时适合穿短裤，短裤的英文是 ___。
questions.analysis: shorts 表示短裤。

questions.stem: It is rainy today 是描述天气的句子。
questions.analysis: 它是天气描述句。

questions.stem: 适合雨天穿戴的有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都可用于雨天；D ✗ 与雨天无关。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 根据天气为一句穿衣建议配一句英语。

answer.value: 示例：It is hot today. You can wear a T-shirt and shorts.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：天气句 + 衣物句搭配合理。

questions.stem: — What do you wear in summer? — ___
questions.analysis: 问穿什么就答穿什么。
options: I wear a T-shirt and shorts.

questions.stem: 补全问句：___ do you wear at school?
questions.analysis: 用 What 提问。

questions.stem: 回答 What do you wear 时可以用 wear 的现在式。
questions.analysis: 问习惯可用一般现在时。

questions.stem: 与衣物有关的问句有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都与衣物相关；D ✗ 问年龄。所以选 A、B、C。
options: What do you wear in winter?

questions.stem: 写一组问答，询问同学在学校穿什么。

answer.value: 示例：— What do you wear at school? — I wear a white shirt and grey trousers.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：问答对应 + 语法正确。

chapters.name: Unit 4 What sounds can we hear?
chapters.summary: 学习声音相关词汇与感官表达。

questions.stem: We can hear birds ___.
questions.analysis: 鸟会唱歌。

questions.stem: 表示「铃声」的单词是 ___。
questions.analysis: bell 意为铃。

questions.stem: The rain goes pitter-patter 是描写雨声。
questions.analysis: 拟声词描写雨声。

questions.stem: 能发出声音的事物有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都会发出声音；D ✗ 书本身不发声。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写出你每天能听到的三种声音。

answer.value: 示例：I can hear the bell, the birds and the cars every day.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三种声音 + 句子通顺。

questions.stem: I can ___ a car outside.
questions.analysis: 听见用 hear。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官动词 hear 的用法

questions.stem: 补全句子：Listen! The birds are ___ (sing).
questions.analysis: are singing 表示正在唱歌。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官动词 hear 的用法

questions.stem: hear 和 listen 都表示「听」，但 listen 强调主动去听。
questions.analysis: 两者侧重点不同。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官动词 hear 的用法

questions.stem: 下面关于听的表达正确的有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 时态与副词位置有误。所以选 A、B、C。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官动词 hear 的用法
options: I hear a noise loudly yesterday.

questions.stem: 写一句描写你在早晨听到的声音。

answer.value: 示例：In the morning I can hear the birds singing and the bell ringing.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：声音具体 + 结构正确。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官动词 hear 的用法

questions.stem: The music is too ___. Please turn it down.
questions.analysis: 太吵用 loud。

questions.stem: 图书馆里要保持安静，安静可以用单词 ___ 表示。
questions.analysis: quiet 意为安静。

questions.stem: 形容声音轻可以用 soft。
questions.analysis: soft 表示轻柔。

questions.stem: 描述声音的词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 描述声音；D ✗ 味道词。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用 loud 和 quiet 各写一句描述声音的话。

answer.value: 示例：The traffic is very loud in the street. The classroom is quiet in the morning.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两句各用一个词 + 意思正确。

questions.stem: 单词 ship 中 sh 的发音与下面哪个相同？
questions.analysis: she 中 sh 与 ship 相同。

questions.stem: 单词 chair 中 ch 的发音是 ___。
questions.analysis: ch 为清辅音。

questions.stem: 感叹句朗读时通常用降调。
questions.analysis: 感叹句句末降调。

questions.stem: 含 ch 的单词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都含 ch；D ✗ 含 sh。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 朗读下面的感叹句并说明语调：What a nice sound!

answer.value: 示例：这是感叹句，朗读时用降调，语气加强。

questions.analysis: 评分要点：判定句类 + 语调正确。

chapters.name: Unit 5 Where can we see colours?
chapters.summary: 学习颜色词汇与颜色问答。

questions.stem: The sky is ___ on a fine day.
questions.analysis: 晴天的天空是蓝色。

questions.stem: 香蕉成熟时通常是（ ）色，英文是 yellow。
questions.analysis: 香蕉是黄色。

questions.stem: 把 red 和 yellow 混合可以得到橙色。
questions.analysis: 红加黄得橙色。

questions.stem: 属于颜色的词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 是物品。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写出你在教室里能看到的三种颜色。

answer.value: 示例：I can see green, white and brown in our classroom.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三种颜色 + 句子完整。

questions.stem: — What colour is your bag? — ___
questions.analysis: 问颜色答颜色。

questions.stem: 补全问句：What ___ is the flower?
questions.analysis: What colour 询问颜色。

questions.stem: 问多件物品的颜色可以说 What colour are they?
questions.analysis: 复数用 are。

questions.stem: 与颜色有关的问句有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 与颜色无关。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写一组问答，询问并回答你书包的颜色。

answer.value: 示例：— What colour is your schoolbag? — It is black and white.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：问答对应 + 颜色正确。

questions.stem: I like green ___ it is the colour of trees.
questions.analysis: 说明原因用 because。

questions.stem: 补全句子：My favourite colour ___ (be) yellow.
questions.analysis: 单数主语用 is。

questions.stem: 可以说 I like red best. 表示我最喜欢红色。
questions.analysis: like … best 表最喜欢。

questions.stem: 表达颜色喜好的正确句子有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 应为 I like blue very much。所以选 A、B、C。
options: I like colour blue very much.

questions.stem: 说说你最喜欢的颜色和原因。

answer.value: 示例：My favourite colour is blue because it makes me feel calm.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：颜色 + 原因。

questions.stem: She is wearing a ___ skirt.
questions.analysis: 颜色词作定语用原形。

questions.stem: 把句子补充完整：The leaves are ___ in spring.
questions.analysis: 春天树叶是绿色。

questions.stem: 颜色词可以放在名词前作定语。
questions.analysis: 如 a red coat。

questions.stem: 正确的描述有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 词序错误。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用颜色词写两句话描述教室里的物品。

answer.value: 示例：The blackboard is black. The walls are white and the door is brown.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：物品 + 颜色搭配正确。

chapters.name: Unit 6 What are our homes like?
chapters.summary: 学习房间与家具词汇，描述家的样子。

questions.stem: We cook meals in the ___.
questions.analysis: 做饭在厨房。

questions.stem: 表示沙发的是单词 ___。
questions.analysis: sofa 意为沙发。

questions.stem: bedroom 指卧室。
questions.analysis: bedroom 是卧室。

questions.stem: 属于房间的词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都是房间；D ✗ 是家具。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写出你家里有的三个房间。

answer.value: 示例：There is a living room, a kitchen and two bedrooms in my home.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三个房间 + 句子正确。

questions.stem: ___ a sofa in the living room.
questions.analysis: 单数用 There is。

questions.stem: 补全句子：___ two beds in my bedroom.
questions.analysis: 复数用 There are。

questions.stem: There be 句型表示某处存在某物。
questions.analysis: 它表示存在。

questions.stem: 正确的句子有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；D ✓；C ✗ 应为 There are。所以选 A、B、D。
options: There is a desk in my room.
There are three chairs in the kitchen.
There is two cats under the table.
There are some books on the shelf.

questions.stem: 用 There be 句型写两句话描述你的卧室。

answer.value: 示例：There is a bed and a desk in my bedroom. There are two pictures on the wall.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：单复数一致 + 描述具体。

questions.stem: The book is ___ the desk.
questions.analysis: 书在桌上用 on。

questions.stem: 补全句子：The cat is ___ the chair.（在椅子下面）
questions.analysis: 在下面用 under。

questions.stem: in 表示在某个空间里面。
questions.analysis: in 表示在内部。

questions.stem: 表示位置的介词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 是动词。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 描述你的书包放在哪里。

answer.value: 示例：My schoolbag is on the chair, next to the desk.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：介词使用正确。

questions.stem: My home is small ___ very nice.
questions.analysis: 转折用 but。

questions.stem: 补全句子：I like ___ home because it is warm.（填 my 或 I）
questions.analysis: 修饰名词用 my。

questions.stem: 描述家时可以先总说再分说各个房间。
questions.analysis: 先总后分条理清楚。

questions.stem: 描述家时可以写（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 与主题无关。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写三句话介绍你的家。

answer.value: 示例：My home is not big but very nice. There is a living room and a kitchen on the first floor. I like my home because my family is there.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三句连贯 + 内容具体。

chapters.name: Unit 7 What do we do at school?
chapters.summary: 学习学校活动与课程表达。

questions.stem: We ___ sports on the playground.
questions.analysis: 主语 We 用原形。

questions.stem: 在图书馆看书可以说 read books in the ___。
questions.analysis: library 是图书馆。

questions.stem: have lunch at school 表示在学校吃午饭。
questions.analysis: 短语意思正确。

questions.stem: 属于学校活动的短语有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 是居家作息。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写出你在学校做的三件事。

answer.value: 示例：At school I have classes, play sports and read books in the library.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三件事 + 表达正确。

questions.stem: We have English ___ Monday morning.
questions.analysis: 具体某天的上午用 on。

questions.stem: 补全句子：Our class starts ___ eight o'clock.
questions.analysis: 时间点用 at。

questions.stem: 表示星期几前的介词用 on。
questions.analysis: on Monday 表示在周一。

questions.stem: 下面时间与介词的搭配正确的有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 搭配错误。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用英语说说你星期三有什么课。

answer.value: 示例：On Wednesday we have Chinese, Maths and Art.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：介词正确 + 课程名称正确。

questions.stem: — When do you have PE lessons? — ___
questions.analysis: 问时间答时间。

questions.stem: 补全问句：___ do you do after class?
questions.analysis: 询问做什么。

questions.stem: 回答 When 的问题要说出时间。
questions.analysis: When 问时间。

questions.stem: 可以询问学校生活的问题有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都与学校生活相关；D ✗ 问家人。所以选 A、B、C。
options: What do you do after class?

questions.stem: 写一组问答，询问同学课后做什么。

answer.value: 示例：— What do you do after class? — I often play basketball with my friends.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：问答匹配 + 语法正确。

questions.stem: 单词 school 中字母组合 oo 的发音为长音，与下面哪个相同？
questions.analysis: school 与 afternoon 中 oo 读音相同。

questions.stem: 特殊疑问句通常读（ ）调（填升或降）。
questions.analysis: 特殊疑问句句末降调。

questions.stem: class 中 a 的发音与 cat 中 a 的发音相同。
questions.analysis: class 中 a 读长音。

questions.stem: 含 oo 的单词有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都含 oo；D ✗ 不含。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 朗读问句并说明语调：What do you do after class?

answer.value: 示例：这是特殊疑问句，朗读时句末用降调。

questions.analysis: 评分要点：判定句类 + 语调说明。

chapters.name: Unit 8 What do you do on Children's Day?
chapters.summary: 学习节日活动与祝愿表达。

questions.stem: On Children's Day we ___ songs together.
questions.analysis: 主语 We 用原形 sing。

questions.stem: 看演出可以用 watch a ___。
questions.analysis: show 表示演出。

questions.stem: Children's Day 是六月一日。
questions.analysis: 国际儿童节为 6 月 1 日。

questions.stem: 儿童节可以做的活动有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都是节日活动；D ✗ 不属于节日活动。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写出你儿童节想做的一件事。

answer.value: 示例：On Children's Day I want to play games with my friends and watch a show.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：活动具体 + 表达正确。

questions.stem: Children's Day is ___ June 1st.
questions.analysis: 具体日期用 on。

questions.stem: 补全句子：The show starts ___ two o'clock.
questions.analysis: 时刻前用 at。

questions.stem: 日期与星期的前面用介词 on。
questions.analysis: on 用于具体日期。

questions.stem: 下面日期与时间的表达正确的有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 搭配错误。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 用英语说明儿童节在什么时候。

answer.value: 示例：Children's Day is on June 1st. We have a party in the morning.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：日期表达正确 + 句子完整。

questions.stem: — Happy Children's Day! — ___
questions.analysis: 收到祝愿礼貌回应感谢。

questions.stem: 补全祝愿语：Happy ___ Day!
questions.analysis: 节日祝愿用 Happy + 节日名。

questions.stem: Happy birthday! 与 Happy Children's Day! 都是祝愿语。
questions.analysis: 两者都是祝福表达。

questions.stem: 属于祝愿语的有（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓ 都是祝愿；D ✗ 是陈述年龄。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写两句儿童节对同学说的话。

answer.value: 示例：Happy Children's Day! Let's sing and play games together.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：祝愿 + 邀请。

questions.stem: We are very ___ on Children's Day.
questions.analysis: be 动词后接形容词。

questions.stem: 补全句子：I ___ (like) Children's Day very much.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 用原形。

questions.stem: 描述节日时可以按时间顺序写活动。
questions.analysis: 按时序写条理清楚。

questions.stem: 描述儿童节时可以写（ ）。
questions.analysis: A ✓；B ✓；C ✓；D ✗ 与节日主题无关。所以选 A、B、C。

questions.stem: 写三句话讲讲你去年儿童节是怎么过的。

answer.value: 示例：Last Children's Day I went to the park with my parents. We sang songs and played games. I was very happy that day.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：三句连贯 + 时态基本正确。
